The '''Beastmaster Chem Lure''' was a device made by [[Corellian Chemical Corporation/Legends|Corellian Chemical Corporation]] and used by hunters. Instead of a [[Beast call/Legends|beast call]], it used pheromones to lure beasts.<ref name="ETU" />
